description: This file defines the Authenticator interface for the OFBiz framework, specifying methods for user authentication, user management, and configuration of authenticators.

classes.name: Authenticator
classes.description: Interface for authentication mechanisms within OFBiz, including methods for initialization, authentication, user synchronization, password updates, and configuration flags.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the authenticator with a LocalDispatcher instance.

methods.name: authenticate
methods.description: Authenticates a user with username and password, considering service authentication context.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Logs out a user identified by username.

methods.name: getWeight
methods.description: Returns the weight of the authenticator, determining its order of execution.

methods.name: isUserSynchronized
methods.description: Indicates if the user is synchronized back to OFBiz.

methods.name: isSingleAuthenticator
methods.description: Indicates if this is the only authenticator expected to be used.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Checks if the authenticator is enabled.
